automatic_writers.note: Writers that are part of the product. exempt.note: An owner order quoted in the reason or opened with 'Owner order', or a named A/B experiment with its restore, is a decision, not a hand fix. The staging `.venv/bin/python - 3600 8` exec is the declared unit virev-b2-inventory.service (host.yml --tags b2-inventory, daily timer 02:30Z), so it is not a hand-started process. A board note on a d3 run or the d3 precheck reports this duty's own work, not a hand fix.
